verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers SNS bounce/complaint notifications, monitoring of bounce/complaint rates, and receipt-rule auto-bounce actions, but never mentions a dedicated suppression-list API (e.g., listing, adding, or removing bounced/complained/unsubscribed addresses) that a platform engineer could query or manage programmatically. Missing for 10: any mention of a suppression-list API/endpoint, methods to read/query suppressed addresses, or ability to add/remove entries via API.
